checks.detail: A Euclidean/sup-norm ball around x is contained in the supplied open U; each coordinate-hybrid path stays inside that ball.
Every scalar path derivative is obtained from the actual coordinate derivative at the corresponding path point; no global derivative or smooth extension is assumed.
The scalar mean-value bound applies on every path edge, and the finite telescoping sum yields the actual Frechet little-o estimate with epsilon/(m+1).
Only continuity of each derivative component at x is used, with an ordinary finite simultaneous neighborhood.

scope_qualification: These are local calculus/support results. The finite regularity premise is ordinary affine noncoincidence and is independently discharged volume-almost-everywhere for the actual residual family by ae_residualThresholdRegularity; no full H1 quantitative estimate is claimed.
